questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Lakhpati Didi initiative:
1. It was launched in 2023 under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission.
2. A revised target of 6 crore Lakhpati Didis by March 2029 has been set.
3. It is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The initiative sits under DAY-NRLM of the Ministry of Rural Development, not the Ministry of Women and Child Development. After reaching 3 crore a year ahead of the March 2027 target, the Centre set a new goal of 6 crore by March 2029.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana:
1. It aims to provide free electricity up to 300 units a month to one crore households through rooftop solar by 2027.
2. It is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy launched in 2024.
3. Households that have already availed another rooftop solar subsidy are also eligible.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme, launched in 2024 by MNRE as a Central Sector Scheme, targets one crore rooftop solar installations and about 30 lakh households have already benefited. A household must not have availed any other rooftop solar subsidy, so statement 3 is wrong.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Vibrant Villages Programme-II (VVP-II):
1. It is a Central Sector Scheme with an outlay of Rs 6,839 crore till FY2028-29.
2. It covers border villages in 17 States and Union Territories, excluding the northern border covered by VVP-I.
3. It is funded 60 per cent by the Centre and 40 per cent by the States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: VVP-II is a Central Sector Scheme and is 100 per cent Centre-funded, so there is no 60:40 sharing with States. It covers villages along borders other than the northern border, which VVP-I handles, across 17 States and Union Territories.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Forest Rights Act cells under the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyaan (DAJGUA):
1. The Tribal Affairs Ministry has sanctioned 324 district-level cells in 18 States and Union Territories.
2. DAJGUA was launched in October 2024.
3. The Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises only individual forest rights.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Ministry has sanctioned 324 district-level cells in 18 States/UTs and 17 State-level cells, and DAJGUA began in October 2024. The Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises individual rights, community rights and community forest resource rights, not individual rights alone.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the PM-SURAJ portal:
1. It is a portal of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
2. It disbursed Rs 1,389.61 crore to 1.39 lakh entrepreneurs from disadvantaged sections in 2024-25.
3. Its business loans are routed through NABARD and SIDBI.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PM-SURAJ is a Social Justice Ministry portal that disbursed Rs 1,389.61 crore to 1.39 lakh entrepreneurs in 2024-25. Loans of up to Rs 15 lakh for new businesses are routed through NSFDC, NSKFDC and NBCFDC, the corporations for SCs, safai karamcharis and backward classes, not through NABARD or SIDBI.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the RAMP programme reviewed by the National MSME Council in February 2026:
1. It is a World Bank-assisted scheme of the Ministry of MSME running from 2022-23 to 2026-27.
2. MSME GIFT is the sub-scheme for green finance.
3. MSE ODR is the sub-scheme for credit guarantees to micro and small enterprises.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: RAMP (Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance) is World Bank-assisted and runs from 2022-23 to 2026-27. MSME GIFT covers green finance, MSE SPICE the circular economy and MSE ODR online dispute resolution for delayed payments, not credit guarantees.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Rashtriya Karmayogi Large Scale Jan Seva Programme:
1. The Capacity Building Commission reported that 10.5 lakh government servants have been trained under it.
2. The Capacity Building Commission is the executive body of the Mission Karmayogi framework.
3. It is meant for private-sector employees.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Capacity Building Commission, the executive body of Mission Karmayogi, reported 10.5 lakh trained. The programme is a behavioural transformation initiative for civil servants that stresses Seva Bhav and Svadharma, not for private-sector staff.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about announcements in the Union Budget 2026-27 relating to agriculture, health and disability:
1. Bharat-VISTAAR, a multilingual AI tool for farm advisory and risk reduction, was announced.
2. A scheme to help States set up five regional medical hubs for medical tourism was announced.
3. The Divyang Kaushal Yojana provides customised training for senior citizens.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Bharat-VISTAAR integrates AgriStack with AI for farm advice and a scheme for five regional medical hubs was announced. The Divyang Kaushal Yojana is for customised training of persons with disabilities, not senior citizens. Health received Rs 1,06,530.42 crore, about 10 per cent above the revised estimate.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025:
1. India's rank improved from 96th to 91st with a score of 39.
2. Denmark ranked first for the eighth consecutive time with a score of 89.
3. The index measures citizens' direct experience of corruption through household surveys.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India improved from 96th to 91st with a score of 39, and Denmark topped the index with 89 for the eighth time. The index is a composite of expert and business assessments of perceived public sector corruption; it excludes citizens' direct experience and private sector corruption.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Network Readiness Index 2025:
1. It is published by the Portulans Institute.
2. India ranked 45th among 127 economies, up four places, with a score of 54.43.
3. It is published by the World Economic Forum.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Network Readiness Index is published by the Portulans Institute, not the World Economic Forum. India rose four places to 45th among 127 economies with a score of 54.43 and ranked first in four indicators, including AI scientific publications and ICT services exports.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about UNESCO's State of the Education Report for India 2025 titled 'Bhasha Matters':
1. It is the 7th edition of the series.
2. It says about 44 per cent of children start school in a language other than the medium of instruction.
3. It recommends English as the sole medium of instruction in all schools.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 7th State of the Education Report for India says about 44 per cent of children begin school in a language different from the medium of instruction and recommends a National Mission for mother-tongue-based multilingual education. It does not recommend English as the sole medium.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Gender Budget in India:
1. The share of Gender Budget in the total Union Budget rose to 9.37 per cent, with 53 Ministries and Departments and five Union Territories reporting.
2. India formally adopted gender budgeting in 2004-05.
3. Part B of the Gender Budget statement lists schemes with 100 per cent provision for women.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Gender Budget share rose to 9.37 per cent and India adopted it in 2004-05. Part A lists schemes with 100 per cent provision for women, while Part B lists schemes where women's allocation is at least 30 per cent, so statement 3 swaps the parts.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Survey on Migration to be conducted by the National Statistics Office:
1. It will be conducted across India from July 2026 to June 2027.
2. The Periodic Labour Force Survey 2020-21 put the overall migration rate at 28.9 per cent.
3. The PLFS 2020-21 migration rate was higher among men (47.9 per cent) than among women (10.7 per cent).
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The NSO survey will run from July 2026 to June 2027 and will capture the extent, nature and reasons for migration, and the PLFS 2020-21 overall migration rate was 28.9 per cent. The gender pattern is reversed: the rate was 47.9 per cent among women and 10.7 per cent among men.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about India in the World Economic Forum's Global Gender Gap Report 2025:
1. India ranked 131st, slipping two places from 129th in 2024.
2. India ranked in the bottom five countries on the Economic Participation and Opportunity subindex.
3. Women are a majority of India's STEM graduates and of its STEM workforce.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: India slipped from 129th to 131st and was in the bottom five on economic participation and opportunity, which highlights the low female labour force participation. Women are about 43 per cent of STEM graduates but only an estimated 27 per cent of the STEM workforce.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the nationwide HPV vaccination programme planned by the Union Health Ministry:
1. It is meant for girls aged 14.
2. HPV causes over 95 per cent of cervical cancers.
3. The HPV vaccine works best when given after the age of 26.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The programme targets girls aged 14, and HPV causes over 95 per cent of cervical cancers. The vaccine works best when given between ages 9 and 26, so statement 3 is wrong.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Tetanus and Adult Diphtheria (Td) vaccine to be launched at Central Research Institute, Kasauli:
1. It combines purified diphtheria and tetanus toxoids adsorbed on aluminium phosphate.
2. CRI Kasauli functions under the Directorate General of Health Services.
3. The Td vaccine also protects against whooping cough.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Td vaccine combines diphtheria and tetanus toxoids adsorbed on aluminium phosphate, and CRI Kasauli works under the DGHS. Td protects only against tetanus and diphtheria, not whooping cough, which needs a pertussis component.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about food and drug regulation in India reported in February 2026:
1. FSSAI advised that chicory content must be displayed prominently on the front of coffee-powder packs.
2. FSSAI is a statutory body under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation is headed by the Director General of Health Services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: FSSAI asked for prominent front-of-pack display of chicory content from 1 July and is a statutory body under the 2006 Act. CDSCO, which works under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, is headed by the Drugs Controller General of India under the Directorate General of Health Services, and it moved to fast-track approvals by issuing NOCs for laboratory testing on receipt of applications.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL):
1. It was set up in 2001 by CSIR and the Ministry of AYUSH.
2. A cooperation arrangement with INPI Brazil raised the number of patent offices with TKDL access to 18.
3. Its formulations are available only in Hindi and Sanskrit.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: TKDL, set up in 2001 by CSIR and the Ministry of AYUSH, signed a cooperation arrangement with INPI Brazil, raising the patent offices with access to 18. Its more than 5.2 lakh formulations are in English, German, French, Japanese and Spanish for use by patent examiners, not in Hindi and Sanskrit.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Ol Chiki script:
1. It was developed in 1925 by Raghunath Murmu for the Santhali language.
2. Santhali was included in the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003.
3. Santhali belongs to the Dravidian language family.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The President inaugurated the centenary of the Ol Chiki script, devised by Raghunath Murmu in 1925. Santhali joined the Eighth Schedule through the 92nd Amendment in 2003 and belongs to the Austroasiatic family, not the Dravidian family.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Tamil Brahmi inscriptions found in Egypt's Valley of the Kings:
1. Researchers identified inscriptions in Tamil Brahmi in the Valley of the Kings, which is part of ancient Thebes.
2. The Valley of the Kings was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979.
3. The inscriptions date from the 1st and 3rd centuries BCE.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The inscriptions, in Tamil Brahmi with some Prakrit and Sanskrit, belong to the 1st and 3rd centuries CE, not BCE, and shed light on ancient trade links. The Valley of the Kings is part of ancient Thebes and a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1979.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Wajid Ali Shah:
1. He was the last Nawab of Awadh, who ascended in 1847 and whose kingdom was annexed by the British in 1856.
2. He is credited with reviving Kathak.
3. His autobiography, Ishqnamah, is in Persian.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of Awadh, is credited with reviving Kathak and built the Qaiserbagh Palace Complex between 1848 and 1850. His autobiography Ishqnamah is in Urdu, not Persian. The British annexed Awadh in 1856 and he died at Metiabruz, Kolkata.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj:
1. He was born on 19 February 1630 at Shivneri Fort near Pune.
2. He is called the Father of the Indian Navy for building a fleet and coastal forts such as Sindhudurg.
3. He replaced Marathi and Sanskrit with Persian in administration.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Shivaji was born at Shivneri on 19 February 1630 and is called the Father of the Indian Navy for his fleet and coastal forts such as Sindhudurg. His administration did the reverse of statement 3: it replaced Persian with Marathi and Sanskrit.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Geographical Indication (GI) products in the news:
1. Bharat GI, an umbrella initiative to showcase India's GI products globally, was launched by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade.
2. Salem Sago (Javvarisi), made from tapioca starch, received its GI tag in 2023.
3. The first export of Salem Sago to Canada was facilitated by DGFT.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: DPIIT unveiled Bharat GI at the AI Impact Summit and Salem Sago got its GI tag in 2023. The first export of 0.5 MT to Canada was facilitated by APEDA, not DGFT.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics:
1. Norway topped the medal table with 18 gold medals, followed by the United States (12) and the Netherlands (10).
2. India sent two athletes and won no medals.
3. The Games were opened at the Verona Arena.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Norway topped the table with 18 golds and India won no medals with two athletes, with alpine skier Arif Khan finishing 39th in the slalom. The Games opened on 6 February 2026 at the San Siro in Milan, while the closing ceremony was held at the Verona Arena.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the entertainment awards of February 2026:
1. At the 68th Grammy Awards, Bad Bunny won Album of the Year, the first primarily Spanish-language album to do so.
2. Kendrick Lamar won five Grammys, including Record of the Year.
3. At the 79th BAFTA Film Awards, 'Sinners' won the most awards, including Best Film.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Bad Bunny's win made history as the first primarily Spanish-language Album of the Year, and Kendrick Lamar took five awards including Record of the Year. At the BAFTAs, 'One Battle After Another' won six awards including Best Film, while 'Sinners' won three.
